test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: are.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given verbs.
 
 
• Are: (Present tense) It is used when the subject is plural or there is more than one noun or pronoun.
 
• Will be: (Future tense) It is used to refer to actions that will be happening in the future, for which the specific time is unknown. It is used as a helping verb to denote the simple future tense.
 
• Is: (Present tense) It is used only when the subject is singular.
 
• Has been: (Perfect tense) It is only used with a third-person singular subject including the pronouns she, he, and it or for actions that have been completed or have happened in a period up to now.
 
 
 
• "**Majority**" on its own is singular. However, if we write about a majority of some specified group, we should use the plural form, "**are**."
 
• In this given passage "**the majority of them**" is mentioned.
 
• Therefore, "are" should be used in this sentence.
 
• So, as per the use of the given verbs "are" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Complete passage: Stray dogs reside on the streets or in neighbourhoods and slums, where they feed on unsanitary waste made by the people who *(1) live__* there. They frequently do not have enough food to eat, and as a result, the majority of them ***__(2) are__*** malnourished. Local area (3)____________ is also a source of worry, as just a few individuals treat them with kindness, while the majority regard them as a (4)___________. In addition, they are subjected to harsh practices such as (5)_______________ and beating.
